Collection Description
HW06 / Pool B / FR-11 - Order history. Spec: GET /api/orders/my-orders (Bearer token) -> the caller's orders. Also covers GET /api/orders/:id and PUT /api/orders/:id/cancel, the two routes FR-11 governs alongside it. Generated from scripts/cases/api3_fr11_order_history.py. FR-11's rule that a user may see only their own orders makes this the home for ownership and IDOR testing; FR-10's state machine is exercised through the history view, with a case for every ILLEGAL transition as well as every legal one. Each case builds its own users and orders in a pre-request fixture, so no case depends on another having run first. --- CI REGRESSION GATE - generated, do not edit. Contains the 84 of 94 cases that passed the run recorded in reports/API3_FR11_OrderHistory.json. The remaining 10 fail because the SUT violates the specification; they are tracked in docs/bugs/BUG_REPORT.md, not here. Refresh with: python scripts/render-cases.py --api 3 --refresh-gate
